name: godd

properties.local: One browser profile on one machine. Not synced. Not uploaded.
properties.writable: Every write in the OS lands here, including edits to global files.
properties.shadowing: A GOD path hides the DOG path of the same name, without altering it.
properties.whiteout: Deleting a DOG path writes a tombstone. It hides the file on this device only.
properties.portable: `export` gives you the whole layer as JSON. `import` puts it on another device.

device-id: SHA-256 over user agent, language, screen size, timezone offset and core count, truncated to 48 bits. Stable for this machine, and it never leaves it.
